doc.name: scholarize
doc.instructions: Scholarize study tools. No account or email needed: generate_study_plan (week-by-week plan from a syllabus or topic list), generate_thesis_statement (thesis options for an essay topic) and generate_citation (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard or IEEE). With a connected Scholarize account: ask_ai_tutor (step-by-step explanations, counts toward the plan), generate_quiz and generate_flashcards (saved to the account), and list_my_quizzes / list_my_flashcards. Accounts at scholar.0xpi.com.

tools.name: generate_study_plan
tools.title: Generate a personalized study plan
tools.description: Create a personalized week-by-week study plan for a student from their syllabus, exam topics, or a description of what they need to study. Returns the plan summary and a shareable link to the full plan. No account or email needed. Use it when a student asks for help planning their studying or exam prep.

syllabus.description: The syllabus, exam topics, or a description of what to study (at least ~10 characters).
examples: Biology exam: cell division, genetics, evolution

email.description: Optional. The student’s email, only if they choose to give it. Not needed for the result.

tools.name: generate_thesis_statement
tools.title: Generate essay thesis statements
tools.description: Generate strong thesis statement options for an essay from a topic, the essay type (argumentative, expository, analytical, compare-contrast), and an optional stance. No account or email needed. Use it when a student needs a thesis or essay direction.

examples: The impact of social media on teenage mental health

email.description: Optional. The student’s email, only if they choose to give it. Not needed for the result.

tools.name: generate_citation
tools.title: Generate a citation in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard and IEEE
tools.description: Generate a formatted citation for a source in five styles (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE) from the source type and details. No account or email needed. Use it when a student needs to cite a book, journal article, website, or other source for an essay or paper.

type.description: Source type: book, journal, website, newspaper or report.

authors.description: Author names as a list, e.g. ["Smith, J.", "Doe, A."].

url.description: URL (for a website or online source).

email.description: Optional. The student’s email, only if they choose to give it. Not needed for the result.

tools.name: ask_ai_tutor
tools.title: Ask the Scholarize Tutor
tools.description: Ask the Scholarize Tutor a question and get a step-by-step explanation, on the connected student account (counts toward their plan). Use for "explain X", "help me understand Y", or homework/concept questions. Requires the student to have connected their Scholarize account to this assistant (a token from Scholarize Settings).

question.description: The question to ask the tutor.

tools.name: generate_quiz
tools.title: Generate a practice quiz
tools.description: Generate a practice quiz on a topic for the connected student, saved to their Scholarize account. Requires a connected Scholarize account.

tools.name: generate_flashcards
tools.title: Generate flashcards
tools.description: Generate a set of study flashcards from a topic or from pasted notes, saved to the connected student Scholarize account. Requires a connected Scholarize account.

notes.description: Optional notes/document text to build cards from.

tools.name: list_my_flashcards
tools.title: List my flashcard sets
tools.description: List the connected student saved flashcard sets in Scholarize. Requires a connected Scholarize account.

tools.name: list_my_quizzes
tools.title: List my quizzes
tools.description: List the connected student saved quizzes in Scholarize. Requires a connected Scholarize account.

prompts.name: make-study-plan
prompts.title: Make me a study plan
prompts.description: Generate a personalized study plan for a student.

prompts.name: write-thesis
prompts.title: Help me write a thesis statement
prompts.description: Generate thesis statement options for an essay.

prompts.name: cite-a-source
prompts.title: Cite a source
prompts.description: Generate a citation for a source in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard and IEEE.
